events.speaker: Narrator
events.text: {user} is a wealthy citizen of the Country of Illyria. He has just set sail to the Island of Ipswich, where he has been invited to a festival. He has brought 4 crew members along, Jonas, Miller, Owl, Pyro. Please read the character list for more information about an individual.

events.speaker: {user}
events.text: (The ship has just set sail, let's head to the cabin for dinner.)

events.speaker: Owl
events.text: There you are {user}, we have been looking for you for a long time now. Where have you been?

events.speaker: {user}
events.text: Looking at the beautiful night sky, of course.

events.speaker: Miller
events.text: We've baked some potatoes, here, have some!

options.text: Thank you! I'd love to have some

events.speaker: Jonas
events.text: So, what's everyone going to Ipswich for?

events.speaker: Pyro
events.text: I found a job there. A 4-star chef in a local restaurant. I could make dinner for ya'll everyday. Some pre-training if you know what I mean.

events.speaker: Owl
events.text: We got some spices downstairs. I'm wondering what you can cook up. Don't explode the kitchen.

events.speaker: Jonas
events.text: You'd be the one to explode it. I'm Owl's brother, and we're going to visit our grandparents there.

events.speaker: Jonas
events.text: Last time Owl tried to make an omelet, we had to call the fire department.

events.speaker: Miller
events.text: Okay enough joking, this is serious business, we might all drown!

events.speaker: Owl
events.text: Alright, alright. Where are you headin' lady?

events.speaker: Miller
events.text: I was invited to a festival there. I think it was called the Chime Festival, it's supposed to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Golden Bell.

events.speaker: Pyro
events.text: The Golden Bell?

events.speaker: Miller
events.text: 50 years ago, a man named Fredrick D. Martinez brilliantly defended Ipswich from a group of strong pirates. He found a giant golden bell and gifted it to the Island's ruler.

events.speaker: Pyro
events.text: What an interesting story...

events.speaker: Miller
events.text: And you {user}? Why are you going to Ipswich?

options.text: I'm going to the festival too! We can go together if you'd like.

events.speaker: Pyro
events.text: What a night of introductions. I’m tired. See you guys tomorrow.

events.speaker: Owl
events.text: I think I’ve had enough social interaction today.

events.speaker: Jonas
events.text: Seems like a successful meeting. Time for sleep. See ya’ll.

events.speaker: Miller
events.text: … {user}?

options.text: This is so romantic, right? That's what you were about to say!
